groups.defect: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits abstract members without implementing them, making the registered handler uninstantiable and causing detector processing to crash.
groups.rationale: All three report the same inheritance change and resulting instantiation failure. Differences in enumerated abstract members and proposed fixes do not identify separate defects.

groups.defect: The mock occurrence helper ignores value, allowing incorrect expected values and failing to test whether the occurrence hook receives the correct per-group value.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same unused helper parameter and cite the same three mismatched expectations as evidence of the same testing gap.
